scripts.dev: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp theme activate lootus && wp-env run cli wp lootus-config apply && npm run local:translations && wp-env run cli wp lootus-local seed
scripts.config:apply: wp-env run cli wp lootus-config apply
scripts.local:translations: wp-env run cli sh -c 'PAGER=cat WP_CLI_PAGER=cat wp language core install de_DE --activate && PAGER=cat WP_CLI_PAGER=cat wp language plugin install woocommerce de_DE && PAGER=cat WP_CLI_PAGER=cat wp language plugin install woocommerce-gateway-stripe de_DE'
scripts.local:seed: wp-env run cli wp lootus-local seed
